fields.name: access_token
fields.help: Partner API client access token (Partner Dashboard > Settings > Partner API clients, with the View financials permission for transactions and Manage apps for app data); 'The API client access token must belong to the organization that you're querying'. Sent as X-Shopify-Access-Token (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/partner/latest).

config_fields.name: organization_id
config_fields.help: Partner organization id from the Partners Dashboard URL (https://partners.shopify.com/{organization_id}/...); part of every endpoint URL.

adapter.envelope_note: GraphQL failures arrive as HTTP 200 {data: null, errors: [...]} and become error results.
adapter.terms: Partner API data covers the partner organization's own apps and earnings; app listings are created and submitted only in the Partner Dashboard.

me.note: The Partner API has no organization / viewer query; the probe runs publicApiVersions against the organization endpoint to prove that organization_id and the token work.

get_product.note: app(id) with `product_id` = the app's Partner gid (e.g. gid://partners/App/1234): id, name, apiKey (raw). The Partner API carries no listing text, price or status for an app.

body.query: =query($first: Int!, $createdAtMin: DateTime, $appId: ID) { transactions(first: $first, createdAtMin: $createdAtMin, appId: $appId, types: [APP_ONE_TIME_SALE, APP_SUBSCRIPTION_SALE, APP_USAGE_SALE]) { edges { node { __typename id createdAt ... on AppSubscriptionSale { id createdAt netAmount { amount currencyCode } grossAmount { amount currencyCode } app { id name } shop { myshopifyDomain name } } ... on AppOneTimeSale { id createdAt netAmount { amount currencyCode } grossAmount { amount currencyCode } app { id name } shop { myshopifyDomain name } } ... on AppUsageSale { id createdAt netAmount { amount currencyCode } grossAmount { amount currencyCode } app { id name } shop { myshopifyDomain name } } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage } } }

list_sales.note: transactions(types: APP_ONE_TIME_SALE, APP_SUBSCRIPTION_SALE, APP_USAGE_SALE; createdAtMin = `since` as an ISO-8601 DateTime; appId = `product_id` gid). `amount` is netAmount.amount (your earnings after Shopify's fee; a decimal string; grossAmount and shopifyFee are in raw), `status` is the transaction type; merchant emails are not exposed (the shop's myshopifyDomain and name are under raw.node.shop), so `customer_email` is null. Cursor-paginated: only the first `limit` transactions are returned (raw pageInfo.hasNextPage) and `page` is not honoured.

body.query: =query($first: Int!, $createdAtMin: DateTime) { transactions(first: $first, createdAtMin: $createdAtMin, types: [APP_SALE_ADJUSTMENT]) { edges { node { __typename id createdAt ... on AppSaleAdjustment { id createdAt netAmount { amount currencyCode } grossAmount { amount currencyCode } app { id name } shop { myshopifyDomain name } chargeId } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage } } }

list_refunds.note: App sale adjustments (refunds and other negative corrections of app charges) since `since` (ISO-8601 DateTime): amount is the (negative) netAmount; sale_id is the adjusted charge id. First `limit` rows only (cursor pagination).

not_offered.list_products: The Partner API QueryRoot has an app(id) lookup but no query that lists an organization's apps (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/partner/latest).
not_offered.create_product: Apps are created and submitted for App Store review in the Partner Dashboard; the Partner API reference has no app-creation operation (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/partner/latest).
not_offered.update_price: App pricing plans are edited in the Partner Dashboard; the Partner API reference documents no pricing write (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/partner/latest).
not_offered.get_sales_stats: The Partner API returns individual transactions only; no earnings summary query exists (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/partner/latest/queries/transactions).
not_offered.refund: No refund operation for app charges is documented in the Partner API reference (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/partner/latest); refunds are issued from the Partner Dashboard.

evidence: host partners.shopify.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Google Trust Services)
probe: 4/4 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific

HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 0/4 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; names not found on the page: get_product:variables, list_refunds:query, list_refunds:variables, list_sales:variables
